correctness.rationale: The 24-vertex 48-edge graph is reconstructed from signed coordinate labels of the small rhombicuboctahedron, not the great variant. Independently executed actual verify_morse.py: 13,874 nonempty independent masks, 6,934 genuine face pairs and a complete topological sort of all 13,874 vertices of the reversed Hasse digraph with 70,536 incidences, proving acyclicity. Critical cells are one 0-cell, one 4-cell, four 5-cells. Exact oriented Morse recursion gives all four integral 5-to-4 boundary degrees 0; maps S4→S4 classified by degree, so all four 5-cells attach null-homotopically and homotopy type is S4 wedge four S5. Not merely mod-two Betti inference.
